panels.title: Services up
panels.description: Health-endpoint probes currently succeeding (5 expected: api-gateway, auth-service, patient-service, billing-service, analytics-service).

panels.title: Total patients
panels.description: Patients in the database (patient-service).

panels.title: Total users
panels.description: Staff accounts that can sign in (auth-service).

panels.title: Billing accounts
panels.description: Billing accounts opened via gRPC since billing-service started.

panels.title: Successful HTTP requests
panels.description: 2xx/3xx responses in the selected time range (actuator excluded).

panels.title: Failed HTTP requests
panels.description: 4xx/5xx responses in the selected time range.

panels.title: Uptime (selected range)
panels.description: Share of successful /actuator/health probes across all services.

panels.title: Service health (1 = up)
panels.description: Blackbox probe of every /actuator/health endpoint.

panels.title: SLI / SLO  (targets: availability 99.9 %, success rate 99 %, latency < 500 ms for 95 % of requests)
Success-rate SLI
panels.description: Share of requests that did NOT fail with 5xx. SLO: 99 %

panels.title: Latency SLI  (< 500 ms)
panels.description: Share of requests served in under 500 ms. SLO: 95 %

panels.title: Error budget left (availability)
panels.description: 1 - (observed downtime / allowed downtime of a 99.9 % SLO).

panels.title: Error budget left (success rate)
panels.description: 1 - (observed 5xx ratio / allowed 1 % for a 99 % SLO).

panels.title: Apdex-style satisfaction
panels.description: Satisfied < 250 ms, tolerating < 1 s (counts half), frustrated above.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - (sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service",http_route!~"/actuator.*",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service",http_route!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])))) / sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service",http_route!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (all selected services)

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service",http_route!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Patients registered
panels.description: Successful creates in the selected time range.

panels.title: Rejected / failed operations
panels.description: Duplicate e-mails (conflict), unknown ids (not_found) and errors (e.g. billing-service down).

panels.title: Analytics events consumed
panels.description: Patient events processed by analytics-service from the Kafka topic 'patient'.

panels.title: Registration pipeline / min (patient -> billing gRPC -> Kafka -> analytics)
panels.description: All four lines should move together; a gap shows where the pipeline is losing or delaying work.

panels.title: Node CPU
panels.description: Host CPU utilisation (node-exporter).

panels.title: Node memory
panels.description: Host memory utilisation (node-exporter).

panels.title: Containers above 50 % CPU
panels.description: Containers currently breaching the CPU alert threshold.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (service) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[2m]), "service", "$1", "name", "(.*)")) / sum by (service) (label_replace(container_spec_cpu_quota{name!=""} / container_spec_cpu_period{name!=""}, "service", "$1", "name", "(.*)") > 0)) > 50) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers above 50 % memory
panels.description: Containers currently breaching the memory alert threshold.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (service) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{name!=""}, "service", "$1", "name", "(.*)")) / sum by (service) (label_replace(container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{name!=""}, "service", "$1", "name", "(.*)") > 0)) > 50) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container CPU % of limit
panels.description: Alert: > 50 % for 2 min

panels.title: Container memory % of limit
panels.description: Alert: > 50 % for 2 min
